055/**
056 * The class translates predicates in GBIF download API to equivalent Elasticsearch query requests.
057 * The json string provided by {@link #buildQuery(Predicate)} can be used with _search get requests
058 * of ES index to produce downloads.
059 */
060@RequiredArgsConstructor
061@Slf4j
062public abstract class EsQueryVisitor<S extends SearchParameter> implements QueryVisitor {
063
064  private final EsFieldMapper<S> esFieldMapper;
065  private final UUID defaultChecklistKey;
066
067  private UUID getChecklistKey(Predicate predicate) {
068
069    if (predicate == null) return null;
070
071    Class<?> clazz = predicate.getClass();
072
073    try {
074      Method m = clazz.getMethod("getChecklistKey");
075      UUID checklistKey = (UUID) m.invoke(predicate);
076      if (checklistKey != null) return checklistKey;
077      return defaultChecklistKey;
078    } catch (Exception e) {
079      return null;
080    }
081  }
082
083  private String getExactMatchFieldName(IsNotNullPredicate<S> predicate) {
084    if (esFieldMapper.isTaxonomic(predicate.getParameter())) {
085      return esFieldMapper.getChecklistField(getChecklistKey(predicate), predicate.getParameter());
086    }
087
088    return esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(predicate.getParameter());
089  }
090
091  private String getExactMatchFieldName(IsNullPredicate<S> predicate) {
092    if (esFieldMapper.isTaxonomic(predicate.getParameter())) {
093      return esFieldMapper.getChecklistField(getChecklistKey(predicate), predicate.getParameter());
094    }
095
096    return esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(predicate.getParameter());
097  }
098
099  private String getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(SimplePredicate<S> predicate) {
100    if (predicate instanceof EqualsPredicate) {
101      EqualsPredicate<S> equalsPredicate = (EqualsPredicate<S>) predicate;
102      if (esFieldMapper.isTaxonomic(equalsPredicate.getKey())) {
103        return esFieldMapper.getChecklistField(
104            getChecklistKey(equalsPredicate), predicate.getKey());
105      }
106    }
107    if (predicate instanceof LikePredicate) {
108      LikePredicate<S> likePredicate = (LikePredicate<S>) predicate;
109      if (esFieldMapper.isTaxonomic(likePredicate.getKey())) {
110        return esFieldMapper.getChecklistField(getChecklistKey(likePredicate), predicate.getKey());
111      }
112    }
113
114    return predicate.isMatchCase()
115        ? esFieldMapper.getVerbatimFieldName(predicate.getKey())
116        : esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(predicate.getKey());
117  }
118
119  private String getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(InPredicate<S> predicate) {
120    if (esFieldMapper.isTaxonomic(predicate.getKey())) {
121      return esFieldMapper.getChecklistField(getChecklistKey(predicate), predicate.getKey());
122    }
123
124    return Optional.ofNullable(predicate.isMatchCase()).orElse(Boolean.FALSE)
125        ? esFieldMapper.getVerbatimFieldName(predicate.getKey())
126        : esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(predicate.getKey());
127  }
128
129  private String parseParamValue(String value, S parameter) {
130    if (OccurrenceStatus.class.isAssignableFrom(parameter.type())) {
131      return VocabularyUtils.lookup(value, OccurrenceStatus.class)
132          .map(OccurrenceStatus::normalize)
133          .map(Enum::name)
134          .orElse(null);
135    }
136    if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(parameter.type())
137        && !Country.class.isAssignableFrom(parameter.type())) {
138      return VocabularyUtils.lookup(value, (Class<Enum<?>>) parameter.type())
139          .map(Enum::name)
140          .orElse(null);
141    }
142    if (Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(parameter.type())) {
143      return value.toLowerCase();
144    }
145    return value;
146  }
147
148  /**
149   * Translates a valid {@link org.gbif.api.model.occurrence.Download} object and translates it into
150   * a json query that can be used as the <em>body</em> for _search request of ES index.
151   *
152   * @param predicate to translate
153   * @return body clause
154   */
155  private static final JsonpMapper JSONP_MAPPER = new JacksonJsonpMapper();
156
157  @Override
158  public String buildQuery(Predicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
159    return getQueryBuilder(predicate)
160        .map(EsQueryVisitor::queryToJson)
161        .orElseGet(EsQueryVisitor::matchAllQueryJson);
162  }
163
164  private static String queryToJson(Query query) {
165    StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
166    try (JsonGenerator g = JSONP_MAPPER.jsonProvider().createGenerator(sw)) {
167      query.serialize(g, JSONP_MAPPER);
168    } catch (Exception e) {
169      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
170    }
171    return sw.toString();
172  }
173
174  private static String matchAllQueryJson() {
175    return queryToJson(Query.of(q -> q.matchAll(m -> m)));
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Translates a valid {@link org.gbif.api.model.occurrence.Download} object and translates it into
180   * a json query that can be used as the <em>body</em> for _search request of ES index.
181   *
182   * @param predicate to translate
183   * @return body clause
184   */
185  public Optional<Query> getQueryBuilder(Predicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
186    if (predicate != null) {
187      QueryData queryData = new QueryData();
188      visit(predicate, queryData);
189      return Optional.of(buildRootBoolQuery(queryData));
190    }
191    return Optional.empty();
192  }
193
194  private static Query buildRootBoolQuery(QueryData queryData) {
195    return buildBoolQuery(
196        queryData.filterQueries, queryData.shouldQueries, queryData.mustNotQueries);
197  }
198
199  private static Query buildBoolQuery(List<Query> filter, List<Query> should, List<Query> mustNot) {
200    return Query.of(
201        q ->
202            q.bool(
203                b -> {
204                  if (filter != null && !filter.isEmpty()) b.filter(filter);
205                  if (should != null && !should.isEmpty()) b.should(should);
206                  if (mustNot != null && !mustNot.isEmpty()) b.mustNot(mustNot);
207                  return b;
208                }));
209  }
210
211  private static Query termQuery(String field, Object value) {
212    return Query.of(q -> q.term(t -> t.field(field).value(FieldValue.of(value))));
213  }
214
215  private static Query termsQuery(String field, List<Object> values) {
216    return Query.of(
217        q ->
218            q.terms(
219                t ->
220                    t.field(field)
221                        .terms(
222                            v ->
223                                v.value(
224                                    values.stream()
225                                        .map(FieldValue::of)
226                                        .collect(Collectors.toList())))));
227  }
228
229  private static Query existsQuery(String field) {
230    return Query.of(q -> q.exists(e -> e.field(field)));
231  }
232
233  private static Query wildcardQuery(String field, String value) {
234    return Query.of(q -> q.wildcard(w -> w.field(field).value(value)));
235  }
236
237  private static Query nestedQuery(String path, Query inner) {
238    return Query.of(q -> q.nested(n -> n.path(path).query(inner).scoreMode(ChildScoreMode.None)));
239  }
240
241  /** Ensure value serializes to JSON (e.g. LocalDate -> string) to avoid Jackson errors. */
242  private static Object toJsonSafe(Object value) {
243    if (value == null) return null;
244    if (value instanceof LocalDate) return value.toString();
245    return value;
246  }
247
248  private static RangeRelation parseRangeRelation(String relation) {
249    if (relation == null) return null;
250    return RangeRelation.valueOf(
251        Character.toUpperCase(relation.charAt(0)) + relation.substring(1).toLowerCase());
252  }
253
254  private static Query rangeQuery(
255      String field, Object gte, Object lte, Object gt, Object lt, String relation) {
256    RangeRelation rangeRelation = parseRangeRelation(relation);
257    return Query.of(
258        q ->
259            q.range(
260                r ->
261                    r.untyped(
262                        u -> {
263                          u.field(field);
264                          if (gte != null) u.gte(JsonData.of(toJsonSafe(gte)));
265                          if (lte != null) u.lte(JsonData.of(toJsonSafe(lte)));
266                          if (gt != null) u.gt(JsonData.of(toJsonSafe(gt)));
267                          if (lt != null) u.lt(JsonData.of(toJsonSafe(lt)));
268                          if (rangeRelation != null) u.relation(rangeRelation);
269                          return u;
270                        })));
271  }
272
273  /**
274   * handle conjunction predicate
275   *
276   * @param predicate conjunction predicate
277   * @param queryData data with the root query builder and the nested path
278   */
279  public void visit(ConjunctionPredicate predicate, QueryData queryData) {
280    Map<String, List<Query>> queriesByNestedPath = new HashMap<>();
281    boolean nonNestedQueriesFound = false;
282
283    // Flatten nested ConjunctionPredicates so that nested-field conditions from inner ANDs
284    // are merged with outer-level nested-field conditions (fixes issue #585).
285    List<Predicate> flatPredicates = flattenConjunction(predicate.getPredicates());
286
287    Map<S, List<SimplePredicate<S>>> rangeBoundsByKey =
288        flatPredicates.stream()
289            .filter(
290                p ->
291                    p instanceof GreaterThanPredicate
292                        || p instanceof GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate
293                        || p instanceof LessThanPredicate
294                        || p instanceof LessThanOrEqualsPredicate)
295            .map(p -> (SimplePredicate<S>) p)
296            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(SimplePredicate::getKey));
297
298    Set<Predicate> handledAsMergedRange = new HashSet<>();
299
300    for (Map.Entry<S, List<SimplePredicate<S>>> entry : rangeBoundsByKey.entrySet()) {
301      List<SimplePredicate<S>> bounds = entry.getValue();
302      if (bounds.size() < 2) {
303        continue;
304      }
305
306      S key = entry.getKey();
307      Object gte = null, lte = null, gt = null, lt = null;
308      for (SimplePredicate<S> bound : bounds) {
309        Object value = parseParamValue(bound.getValue(), key);
310        if (bound instanceof GreaterThanPredicate) {
311          gt = value;
312        } else if (bound instanceof GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate) {
313          gte = value;
314        } else if (bound instanceof LessThanPredicate) {
315          lt = value;
316        } else if (bound instanceof LessThanOrEqualsPredicate) {
317          lte = value;
318        }
319        handledAsMergedRange.add(bound);
320      }
321
322      Query q =
323          addNullableFieldPredicate(
324              bounds.get(0),
325              rangeQuery(esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(key), gte, lte, gt, lt, null));
326      if (esFieldMapper.isNestedField(key)) {
327        // grouped with the other conditions on the same nested path so it's wrapped in a single
328        // nested query below (gbif/occurrence#630)
329        queriesByNestedPath
330            .computeIfAbsent(esFieldMapper.getNestedPath(key), k -> new ArrayList<>())
331            .add(q);
332      } else {
333        queryData.filterQueries.add(q);
334        nonNestedQueriesFound = true;
335      }
336    }
337
338    for (Predicate subPredicate : flatPredicates) {
339      if (handledAsMergedRange.contains(subPredicate)) {
340        continue;
341      }
342      try {
343        QueryData mustQueryData = new QueryData();
344        visit(subPredicate, mustQueryData);
345
346        if (mustQueryData.isNested()) {
347          List<Query> queriesToAdd;
348
349          if (subPredicate instanceof DisjunctionPredicate && mustQueryData.rawQueries.size() > 1) {
350            Query shouldWrapper =
351                buildBoolQuery(
352                    Collections.emptyList(), mustQueryData.rawQueries, Collections.emptyList());
353            queriesToAdd = List.of(addNullableFieldPredicate(subPredicate, shouldWrapper));
354          } else {
355            queriesToAdd =
356                mustQueryData.rawQueries.stream()
357                    .map(rq -> addNullableFieldPredicate(subPredicate, rq))
358                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
359          }
360          queriesByNestedPath
361              .computeIfAbsent(mustQueryData.nestedPath, k -> new ArrayList<>())
362              .addAll(queriesToAdd);
363        } else {
364          Query combined = buildBoolFromQueryData(mustQueryData);
365          queryData.filterQueries.add(addNullableFieldPredicate(subPredicate, combined));
366          nonNestedQueriesFound = true;
367        }
368      } catch (QueryBuildingException ex) {
369        throw new RuntimeException(ex);
370      }
371    }
372
373    for (Map.Entry<String, List<Query>> entry : queriesByNestedPath.entrySet()) {
374      String key = entry.getKey();
375      List<Query> value = entry.getValue();
376      Query nestedBool = buildBoolQuery(value, Collections.emptyList(), Collections.emptyList());
377      queryData.filterQueries.add(nestedQuery(key, nestedBool));
378      queryData.nestedPath = !nonNestedQueriesFound ? key : null;
379      queryData.rawQueries = value;
380    }
381  }
382
383  private static Query buildBoolFromQueryData(QueryData d) {
384    return buildBoolQuery(d.filterQueries, d.shouldQueries, d.mustNotQueries);
385  }
386
387  /**
388   * Recursively flattens nested ConjunctionPredicates into a single list, so that nested-field
389   * conditions from inner ANDs are merged with outer-level conditions during query building.
390   */
391  private static List<Predicate> flattenConjunction(Collection<Predicate> predicates) {
392    List<Predicate> result = new ArrayList<>();
393    for (Predicate p : predicates) {
394      if (p instanceof ConjunctionPredicate) {
395        result.addAll(flattenConjunction(((ConjunctionPredicate) p).getPredicates()));
396      } else {
397        result.add(p);
398      }
399    }
400    return result;
401  }
402
403  /**
404   * handle disjunction predicate
405   *
406   * @param predicate disjunction predicate
407   * @param queryData data with the root query builder and the nested path
408   */
409  public void visit(DisjunctionPredicate predicate, QueryData queryData) {
410    Map<S, List<EqualsPredicate<S>>> equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn = groupEquals(predicate);
411
412    Map<String, List<Query>> queriesByNestedPath = new HashMap<>();
413    boolean nonNestedQueriesFound = false;
414
415    for (Predicate subPredicate : predicate.getPredicates()) {
416      try {
417        if (!isReplaceableByInPredicate(subPredicate, equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn)) {
418          QueryData shouldQueryData = new QueryData();
419          visit(subPredicate, shouldQueryData);
420          Query q =
421              addNullableFieldPredicate(subPredicate, buildBoolFromQueryData(shouldQueryData));
422
423          if (shouldQueryData.isNested()) {
424            queriesByNestedPath
425                .computeIfAbsent(shouldQueryData.nestedPath, k -> new ArrayList<>())
426                .addAll(shouldQueryData.rawQueries);
427          } else {
428            nonNestedQueriesFound = true;
429            queryData.shouldQueries.add(q);
430          }
431
432          if (subPredicate instanceof SimplePredicate) {
433            equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.remove(((SimplePredicate) subPredicate).getKey());
434          }
435        }
436      } catch (QueryBuildingException ex) {
437        throw new RuntimeException(ex);
438      }
439    }
440
441    for (Map.Entry<String, List<Query>> e : queriesByNestedPath.entrySet()) {
442      String s = e.getKey();
443      List<Query> builders = e.getValue();
444      Query nestedBool = buildBoolQuery(Collections.emptyList(), builders, Collections.emptyList());
445      queryData.shouldQueries.add(nestedQuery(s, nestedBool));
446      queryData.nestedPath = !nonNestedQueriesFound ? s : null;
447      queryData.rawQueries = builders;
448    }
449
450    if (!equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.isEmpty()) {
451      Optional<S> geoTimeParam = getParam(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME.name());
452      if (geoTimeParam.isPresent()
453          && equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.containsKey(geoTimeParam.get())) {
454        List<Query> queryBuilders = new ArrayList<>();
455        equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn
456            .get(geoTimeParam.get())
457            .forEach(
458                ep ->
459                    queryBuilders.add(
460                        termQuery(
461                            getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(ep),
462                            parseParamValue(ep.getValue(), ep.getKey()))));
463
464        if (!queryBuilders.isEmpty()) {
465          nonNestedQueriesFound = true;
466          queryData.shouldQueries.addAll(queryBuilders);
467        }
468        equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.remove(geoTimeParam.get());
469      }
470
471      if (!equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.isEmpty()) {
472        Map<String, List<Query>> replaceableQueriesByNestedPath = new HashMap<>();
473        for (InPredicate<S> ep : toInPredicates(equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn)) {
474          Query termsQ =
475              termsQuery(
476                  getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(ep),
477                  ep.getValues().stream()
478                      .map(v -> parseParamValue(v, ep.getKey()))
479                      .collect(Collectors.toList()));
480
481          if (esFieldMapper.isNestedField(ep.getKey())) {
482            replaceableQueriesByNestedPath
483                .computeIfAbsent(esFieldMapper.getNestedPath(ep.getKey()), k -> new ArrayList<>())
484                .add(termsQ);
485          } else {
486            queryData.shouldQueries.add(termsQ);
487            nonNestedQueriesFound = true;
488          }
489        }
490
491        for (Map.Entry<String, List<Query>> entry : replaceableQueriesByNestedPath.entrySet()) {
492          String key = entry.getKey();
493          List<Query> value = entry.getValue();
494          Query nestedBool =
495              buildBoolQuery(Collections.emptyList(), value, Collections.emptyList());
496          queryData.shouldQueries.add(nestedQuery(key, nestedBool));
497          queryData.nestedPath = !nonNestedQueriesFound ? key : null;
498          queryData.rawQueries = value;
499        }
500      }
501    }
502  }
503
504  /** Checks if a predicate has in grouped and can be replaced later by a InPredicate. */
505  private boolean isReplaceableByInPredicate(
506      Predicate predicate, Map<S, List<EqualsPredicate<S>>> equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn) {
507    if (!equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.isEmpty() && predicate instanceof EqualsPredicate) {
508      EqualsPredicate<S> equalsPredicate = (EqualsPredicate<S>) predicate;
509
510      // check it is not a range predicate e.g. YEAR 2000,*
511      if (SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(equalsPredicate.getValue())
512          || SearchTypeValidator.isDateRange(equalsPredicate.getValue())) {
513        return false;
514      }
515
516      return equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn.containsKey(equalsPredicate.getKey())
517          && equalsPredicatesReplaceableByIn
518              .get(equalsPredicate.getKey())
519              .contains(equalsPredicate);
520    }
521    return false;
522  }
523
524  /** Groups all equals predicates by search parameter. */
525  private Map<S, List<EqualsPredicate<S>>> groupEquals(DisjunctionPredicate predicate) {
526    return predicate.getPredicates().stream()
527        .filter(p -> p instanceof EqualsPredicate)
528        .filter(p -> ((EqualsPredicate<?>) p).getChecklistKey() == null)
529        .map(p -> (EqualsPredicate<S>) p)
530        .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(EqualsPredicate::getKey))
531        .entrySet()
532        .stream()
533        .filter(e -> e.getValue().size() > 1)
534        .collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getKey, Map.Entry::getValue));
535  }
536
537  /** Transforms the grouped EqualsPredicates into InPredicates. */
538  private List<InPredicate<S>> toInPredicates(Map<S, List<EqualsPredicate<S>>> equalPredicates) {
539    return equalPredicates.entrySet().stream()
540        .map(
541            e ->
542                e.getValue().stream()
543                    .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(EqualsPredicate::isMatchCase))
544                    .entrySet()
545                    .stream()
546                    .map(
547                        group ->
548                            new InPredicate<S>(
549                                e.getKey(),
550                                group.getValue().stream()
551                                    .map(EqualsPredicate::getValue)
552                                    .collect(Collectors.toSet()),
553                                group.getKey()))
554                    .collect(Collectors.toList()))
555        .flatMap(List::stream)
556        .collect(Collectors.toList());
557  }
558
559  /**
560   * handles EqualPredicate
561   *
562   * @param predicate equalPredicate
563   */
564  public void visit(EqualsPredicate<S> predicate, QueryData queryData) {
565    S parameter = predicate.getKey();
566    String field = esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(parameter);
567    Query q;
568
569    if ((Number.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())
570            || paramEquals(predicate.getKey(), OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME.name()))
571        && SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(predicate.getValue())) {
572      Range<Double> decimalRange = SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(predicate.getValue());
573      Double gte = decimalRange.hasLowerBound() ? decimalRange.lowerEndpoint() : null;
574      Double lte = decimalRange.hasUpperBound() ? decimalRange.upperEndpoint() : null;
575      String rel =
576          paramEquals(predicate.getKey(), OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME.name())
577              ? "within"
578              : null;
579      q = addNullableFieldPredicate(predicate, rangeQuery(field, gte, lte, null, null, rel));
580    } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())
581        && SearchTypeValidator.isDateRange(predicate.getValue())) {
582      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
583      Object gte = dateRange.hasLowerBound() ? dateRange.lowerEndpoint().toString() : null;
584      Object lt = dateRange.hasUpperBound() ? dateRange.upperEndpoint().toString() : null;
585      q = addNullableFieldPredicate(predicate, rangeQuery(field, gte, null, null, lt, "within"));
586    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
587      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
588      Object gte = dateRange.hasLowerBound() ? dateRange.lowerEndpoint().toString() : null;
589      Object lt = dateRange.hasUpperBound() ? dateRange.upperEndpoint().toString() : null;
590      q = addNullableFieldPredicate(predicate, rangeQuery(field, gte, null, null, lt, "within"));
591    } else {
592      q =
593          addNullableFieldPredicate(
594              predicate,
595              termQuery(
596                  getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(predicate),
597                  parseParamValue(predicate.getValue(), parameter)));
598    }
599
600    addFilterQuery(q, queryData, parameter);
601  }
602
603  private final Function<String, Object> parseDate =
604      d -> "*".equals(d) ? null : IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDate(d);
605
606  private final Function<String, Object> parseInteger =
607      d -> "*".equals(d) ? null : Integer.parseInt(d);
608
609  private final Function<String, Object> parseDouble =
610      d -> "*".equals(d) ? null : Double.parseDouble(d);
611
612  public void visit(RangePredicate<S> predicate, QueryData queryData)
613      throws QueryBuildingException {
614    String field = esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(predicate.getKey());
615    Object gte = null, lte = null, gt = null, lt = null;
616    Function<String, Object> initialiser;
617    if (Integer.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
618      initialiser = parseInteger;
619    } else if (Double.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
620      initialiser = parseDouble;
621    } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
622      initialiser = parseDate;
623    } else {
624      addFilterQuery(Query.of(q -> q.matchAll(m -> m)), queryData, predicate.getKey());
625      return;
626    }
627    if (predicate.getValue().getGte() != null)
628      gte = initialiser.apply(predicate.getValue().getGte());
629    if (predicate.getValue().getLte() != null)
630      lte = initialiser.apply(predicate.getValue().getLte());
631    if (predicate.getValue().getGt() != null) gt = initialiser.apply(predicate.getValue().getGt());
632    if (predicate.getValue().getLt() != null) lt = initialiser.apply(predicate.getValue().getLt());
633    Query rqb = rangeQuery(field, gte, lte, gt, lt, null);
634    addFilterQuery(rqb, queryData, predicate.getKey());
635  }
636
637  private static LocalDate parseDate(String d) {
638    return "*".equals(d) ? null : IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDate(d);
639  }

650    Query q =
651        addNullableFieldPredicate(
652            predicate,
653            rangeQuery(
654                esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(parameter), val, null, null, null, null));
655    addFilterQuery(q, queryData, predicate.getKey());

658  /**
659   * Adds an "is null" filter if the mapper instructs to. Used mostly in range queries to give
660   * specific semantics to null values.
661   */
662  private Query addNullableFieldPredicate(Predicate predicate, Query filter) {
663    if (predicate instanceof SimplePredicate
664        && esFieldMapper.includeNullInPredicate((SimplePredicate<S>) predicate)) {
665      String field =
666          esFieldMapper.getExactMatchFieldName(((SimplePredicate<S>) predicate).getKey());
667      Query missing = Query.of(q -> q.bool(b -> b.mustNot(existsQuery(field))));
668      return buildBoolQuery(
669          Collections.emptyList(), List.of(filter, missing), Collections.emptyList());
670    }
671    return filter;
672  }

691  /**
692   * handle IN Predicate
693   *
694   * @param predicate InPredicate
695   * @param queryData data with the root query builder and the nested path
696   */
697  public void visit(InPredicate<S> predicate, QueryData queryData) {
698    S parameter = predicate.getKey();
699
700    if (paramEquals(parameter, OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE.name())) {
701      predicate
702          .getValues()
703          .forEach(
704              value -> {
705                try {
706                  QueryData shouldQueryData = new QueryData();
707                  Predicate subPredicate =
708                      new EqualsPredicate<>(
709                          getParam(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE.name()).get(),
710                          value,
711                          predicate.isMatchCase(),
712                          predicate.getChecklistKey());
713                  visit(subPredicate, shouldQueryData);
714                  queryData.shouldQueries.add(
715                      addNullableFieldPredicate(
716                          subPredicate, buildBoolFromQueryData(shouldQueryData)));
717                } catch (QueryBuildingException ex) {
718                  throw new RuntimeException(ex);
719                }
720              });
721    } else if (paramEquals(parameter, OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME.name())) {
722      List<Predicate> allPredicates =
723          predicate.getValues().stream()
724              .map(v -> new EqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), v, false))
725              .collect(Collectors.toList());
726      visit(new DisjunctionPredicate(allPredicates), queryData);
727    } else {
728      Query termsQ =
729          termsQuery(
730              getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(predicate),
731              predicate.getValues().stream()
732                  .map(v -> parseParamValue(v, parameter))
733                  .collect(Collectors.toList()));
734      addFilterQuery(termsQ, queryData, predicate.getKey());
735    }
736  }

770  /** handles not predicate */
771  public void visit(NotPredicate predicate, QueryData queryData) throws QueryBuildingException {
772    QueryData mustNotQueryData = new QueryData();
773    visit(predicate.getPredicate(), mustNotQueryData);
774
775    QueryData existsQueryData = new QueryData();
776    addNotPredicateNonNullFilters(predicate.getPredicate(), existsQueryData);
777    queryData.filterQueries.addAll(existsQueryData.filterQueries);
778
779    queryData.mustNotQueries.add(buildBoolFromQueryData(mustNotQueryData));
780  }
781
782  private void addNotPredicateNonNullFilters(Predicate predicate, QueryData queryData) {
783    Map<S, Set<String>> fieldsByParameter = new LinkedHashMap<>();
784    collectNotPredicateFields(predicate, fieldsByParameter);
785
786    fieldsByParameter.forEach(
787        (parameter, fields) ->
788            fields.forEach(field -> addFilterQuery(existsQuery(field), queryData, parameter)));
789  }
790
791  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
792  private void collectNotPredicateFields(
793      Predicate predicate, Map<S, Set<String>> fieldsByParameter) {
794    if (predicate instanceof ConjunctionPredicate) {
795      ((ConjunctionPredicate) predicate)
796          .getPredicates()
797          .forEach(p -> collectNotPredicateFields(p, fieldsByParameter));
798    } else if (predicate instanceof DisjunctionPredicate) {
799      ((DisjunctionPredicate) predicate)
800          .getPredicates()
801          .forEach(p -> collectNotPredicateFields(p, fieldsByParameter));
802    } else if (predicate instanceof InPredicate) {
803      InPredicate<S> p = (InPredicate<S>) predicate;
804      addNotPredicateFieldToNonNullChecks(
805          fieldsByParameter, p.getKey(), getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(p));
806    } else if (predicate instanceof SimplePredicate) {
807      SimplePredicate<S> p = (SimplePredicate<S>) predicate;
808      addNotPredicateFieldToNonNullChecks(
809          fieldsByParameter, p.getKey(), getExactMatchOrVerbatimField(p));
810    }
811  }
812
813  private void addNotPredicateFieldToNonNullChecks(
814      Map<S, Set<String>> fieldsByParameter, S parameter, String fieldName) {
815    fieldsByParameter.computeIfAbsent(parameter, ignored -> new LinkedHashSet<>()).add(fieldName);
816  }

829  /** Builds a geo_shape query (WITHIN relation) from WKT geometry. */
830  public Query buildGeoShapeQuery(String wkt) {
831    Geometry geometry;
832    try {
833      geometry = new WKTReader().read(wkt);
834    } catch (ParseException e) {
835      throw new IllegalArgumentException(e.getMessage(), e);
836    }
837
838    String type =
839        "LinearRing".equals(geometry.getGeometryType())
840            ? "LINESTRING"
841            : geometry.getGeometryType().toUpperCase();
842
843    Object geoJson;
844    if (("POINT").equals(type)) {
845      Coordinate c = geometry.getCoordinate();
846      geoJson = Map.of("type", "Point", "coordinates", List.of(c.x, c.y));
847    } else if ("LINESTRING".equals(type)) {
848      geoJson =
849          Map.of(
850              "type",
851              "LineString",
852              "coordinates",
853              Arrays.stream(geometry.getCoordinates())
854                  .map(c -> List.of(c.x, c.y))
855                  .collect(Collectors.toList()));
856    } else if ("POLYGON".equals(type)) {
857      Polygon poly = (Polygon) geometry;
858      List<List<List<Double>>> rings = new ArrayList<>();
859      rings.add(
860          Arrays.stream(normalizePolygonCoordinates(poly.getExteriorRing().getCoordinates()))
861              .map(c -> List.<Double>of(c.x, c.y))
862              .collect(Collectors.toList()));
863      for (int i = 0; i < poly.getNumInteriorRing(); i++) {
864        rings.add(
865            Arrays.stream(normalizePolygonCoordinates(poly.getInteriorRingN(i).getCoordinates()))
866                .map(c -> List.<Double>of(c.x, c.y))
867                .collect(Collectors.toList()));
868      }
869      geoJson = Map.of("type", "Polygon", "coordinates", rings);
870    } else if ("MULTIPOLYGON".equals(type)) {
871      List<List<List<List<Double>>>> polygons = new ArrayList<>();
872      for (int i = 0; i < geometry.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
873        Polygon poly = (Polygon) geometry.getGeometryN(i);
874        List<List<List<Double>>> rings = new ArrayList<>();
875        rings.add(
876            Arrays.stream(normalizePolygonCoordinates(poly.getExteriorRing().getCoordinates()))
877                .map(c -> List.<Double>of(c.x, c.y))
878                .collect(Collectors.toList()));
879        for (int h = 0; h < poly.getNumInteriorRing(); h++) {
880          rings.add(
881              Arrays.stream(normalizePolygonCoordinates(poly.getInteriorRingN(h).getCoordinates()))
882                  .map(c -> List.<Double>of(c.x, c.y))
883                  .collect(Collectors.toList()));
884        }
885        polygons.add(rings);
886      }
887      geoJson = Map.of("type", "MultiPolygon", "coordinates", polygons);
888    } else {
889      throw new IllegalArgumentException(type + " shape is not supported");
890    }
891
892    GeoShapeFieldQuery shapeQuery =
893        GeoShapeFieldQuery.of(s -> s.shape(JsonData.of(geoJson)).relation(GeoShapeRelation.Within));
894    return Query.of(
895        q -> q.geoShape(g -> g.field(esFieldMapper.getGeoShapeField()).shape(shapeQuery)));
896  }
897
898  /** Eliminates consecutive duplicates. The order is preserved. */
899  static Coordinate[] normalizePolygonCoordinates(Coordinate[] coordinates) {
900    List<Coordinate> normalizedCoordinates = new ArrayList<>();
901
902    // we always have to keep the fist and last coordinates
903    int i = 0;
904    normalizedCoordinates.add(i++, coordinates[0]);
905
906    for (int j = 1; j < coordinates.length; j++) {
907      if (!coordinates[j - 1].equals(coordinates[j])) {
908        normalizedCoordinates.add(i++, coordinates[j]);
909      }
910    }
911
912    return normalizedCoordinates.toArray(new Coordinate[0]);
913  }

915  /** handles geoDistance predicate */
916  public void visit(GeoDistancePredicate geoDistance, QueryData queryData) {
917    Query q = buildGeoDistanceQuery(geoDistance.getGeoDistance());
918    queryData.filterQueries.add(q);

921  private Query buildGeoDistanceQuery(DistanceUnit.GeoDistance geoDistance) {
922    return Query.of(
923        q ->
924            q.geoDistance(
925                g ->
926                    g.field(esFieldMapper.getGeoDistanceField())
927                        .distance(geoDistance.getDistance().toString())
928                        .location(
929                            loc ->
930                                loc.latlon(
931                                    ll ->
932                                        ll.lat(geoDistance.getLatitude())
933                                            .lon(geoDistance.getLongitude())))));
934  }

950  private void visit(Object object, QueryData queryData) throws QueryBuildingException {
951    Method method;
952    try {
953      method = getClass().getMethod("visit", object.getClass(), QueryData.class);
954    } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
955      log.warn(
956          "Visit method could not be found. That means a unknown Predicate has been passed", e);
957      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Predicate", e);
958    }
959    try {
960      method.invoke(this, object, queryData);
961    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
962      log.error(
963          "This error shouldn't occur if all visit methods are public. Probably a programming error",
964          e);
965      throw new RuntimeException(e);
966    } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
967      log.info("Exception thrown while building the query", e);
968      throw new QueryBuildingException(e);
969    }
970  }
971
972  private void addFilterQuery(Query q, QueryData queryData, S searchParameter) {
973    if (esFieldMapper.isNestedField(searchParameter)) {
974      queryData.filterQueries.add(nestedQuery(esFieldMapper.getNestedPath(searchParameter), q));
975      queryData.rawQueries = List.of(q);
976      queryData.nestedPath = esFieldMapper.getNestedPath(searchParameter);
977    } else {
978      queryData.filterQueries.add(q);
979    }
980  }

982  @Data
983  public static class QueryData {
984    List<Query> filterQueries = new ArrayList<>();
985    List<Query> shouldQueries = new ArrayList<>();
986    List<Query> mustNotQueries = new ArrayList<>();
987
988    /** Raw queries that go inside a nested query. */
989    List<Query> rawQueries = new ArrayList<>();
990
991    String nestedPath;
992
993    QueryData() {}
994
995    boolean isNested() {
996      return nestedPath != null;
997    }
998  }

1000  private boolean paramEquals(S param1, String param2) {
1001    Optional<S> param2Opt = getParam(param2);
1002    return param2Opt.isPresent() && param1 == param2Opt.get();
1003  }

1005  protected abstract Optional<S> getParam(String name);
